body.statement: For integer \(T,p\), an explicitly listed binary support \(\mathcal S\), and rational \(\epsilon,\Pi,\omega\), there is a terminating exact rational-arithmetic procedure that returns either a nonzero \(v\in\mathbb Q^{d}\) with \(JE_{ab}v=0\) for every \(a<b\), certifying singularity, or the exact tensor \(L(\Pi)\), the exact value \(\mathcal C(\Pi,Q)\), and the complete sign-and-zero table of \(L_{j,t,\ell}(\Pi)-Q_{j,t,\ell}\).
body.justification: The population theorem becomes an auditable diagnostic rather than a numerical auxiliary regression with hidden tolerance choices.
body.gap: Existing event-study weight diagnostics compute realized-design weights numerically; they do not provide exact rational certificates for a counterfactual reshaping law and a calendar-by-causal-lag target.
body.consumer: The \(\texttt{ripw}\) package can export a machine-checkable loading table for each OpenTable specification.
